description:
We would like to replace 7 windows.

All window features are going to be matched “like for like”, with the following exceptions:
-	All windows will be double glazed.
-	According to FENSA all windows are now required to have windowsills protruding out for at least 40 millimetres 
-	This would violate the principle of “replacing like for like” and the new window sills would stand/protrude out compared to the rest of the houses (See Picture 1.)
-	Given that our property is under Article 4, and hence to protect the uniformity / character of the street we would like to apply for:
o	Replacing front windows A,B,C fully “like for like”, i.e. having no window sills, this would ensure that these new windows are “flush” with the wall and don’t stand out but they are going to be non-compliant with Fensa / building regulations (Picture 2).
o	Replacing front ground floor window D with a Fensa compliant window with a sill (Picture 2).
o	Replacing all of the back windows E,F and G with Fensa compliant windows with sills (Picture 3).
